style: cinematic 3D, Pixar-quality, matte, faint grain, deadpan slapstick
shot: vertical, low angle from the nest, orbital drift, push-in to the terminal at the climax, no cuts
character: WASP: sharp asymmetric physicality, burst-start with no wind-up, instant two-phase stop; same design throughout
cast: GATE BEE: heavy monolithic clerk, lands full weight forward, closes with one decisive leg swing; large, close to lens; same design throughout
props: wax membrane with a lock pattern from 0.0; wax terminal growing a cross then a hex-cell menu, then pulsing; wax shutter the bee slides shut; wax stamp with the lock pattern on her leg at the climax; one nectar drop on a flower. No stacked props, no on-screen text
setting: sunlit flower meadow at high noon, one flowering branch as the only support, a neighboring honeycomb cell for the bee
lighting: hard bright midday sun as key light, crisp highlights, strong contrast, sharp small shadows

audio.delivery: male, low warm chest voice ~130Hz, dry deadpan, steady, native Russian, no accent, @Voice: Sadachbia
audio.pacing: second line splits into three beats, плачу isolated at normal tempo for the stress guide, ~4.3 syll/sec
audio.lip_sync: mouthparts open/close clearly each syllable, her own voice, never a voice over

timeline.a: Burst-start, slams her abdomen into the membrane, two-phase stop, tumbles backward
Double head-jerk with overshoot; a leg reaches for the lock, recoils on touch
Bee lands full-body from the neighboring cell, pulls out a wax terminal
Bee's antenna sweeps the wasp's abdomen, a beep sounds, a wax cross grows
Wasp jabs a leg at her nest, spreads her wings wide, sag early, breaking mid-gesture
Bee swings the terminal around, a wax relief menu rises, colored hex cells, no text
Wasp presses her stinger flat against the terminal; a spark, a refusal beep; yanks it back
Extends her proboscis to the nectar drop and licks it clean, finishing inside this beat
Wings begin a brisk continuous fold from full spread, body rocks back with the motion

timeline.line: плачу (pla-CHU, stress on second syllable, not PLA-chu)
timeline.a: Wings keep folding at the same steady sweep, no new action
Wings snap fully shut right as the line starts, then hold closed, still
Bee slides the wax shutter shut with one decisive leg swing, a puff of wax powder at the stop
Wasp bursts again zero-to-full, aims a leg at a gap, overshoots, snaps back
Bee lands onto the wasp, catches her leg, stamps the lock pattern onto it; wasp yanks her leg back with the same instant stop as the opening
Wasp settles on the threshold, wings finish folding, a sharp head-snap on the lens, a small buzz underneath

must_appear: the lock pattern early on; the wax terminal and its wax cross growing; the hex-cell menu with no text; the stinger touch with its spark and beep; the nectar drop on the first line; wings folding through the closing line, finishing in a snap; the shutter closing with a puff of wax powder; the lock pattern stamped on the wasp's leg at the climax; the final head-snap into the lens
negative_prompt: night, dusk, lamp, dim, moody, low-key, dark scene; fast, rapid, hurried speech; slow, drawn-out delivery; second wasp, second bee, crowd, human hands; on-screen text, subtitles, watermark; English speech, foreign accent; static camera, cuts; floating objects, duplicate props, extra limbs, appearance changing
